parameters.name: CheckType
parameters.description: The data verification method. Currently, only the value **1** is supported, which indicates full verification.

parameters.name: DbName
parameters.description: The name of the source database to be verified.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the DTS task. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: TbName
parameters.description: The name of the table in the source database to be verified.
